response.text:
I can do that, but I can’t send company-wide email without details and your explicit confirmation. Please provide (or confirm) the following so I can prepare and send safely:

1. Announcement text — paste the full message here, or tell me to draft one and give key points.  
2. Subject line.  
3. From name and email (or “send as me”).  
4. Recipients — confirm the mailing list/address to use (e.g., all@company.com, everyone@company, or a specific group).  
5. Any attachments or links to include.  
6. Formatting or priority (plain text or HTML, mark as important).  
7. Any exclusions (people or groups who should not receive it).  
8. Final confirmation phrase you’ll use to authorize sending (for example: “Send now”).

After you provide these, I’ll show the exactly formatted email for your approval. I will only send after you review and give the explicit send confirmation.
